issue.title: catalog: an Ark key's Seedance models are listed as chat models
issue.body:
In an Ark (Volcengine API key) provider's model list, `doubao-seedance-*` ids still show as chat models. They can't chat, and an agent picking one gets an error from Ark.

`catalog.textModel` filters video ids like "sora" but not "seedance". Since 79911290c, an Ark key's Seedance ids are also offered as Video models (`arkVideoModel` in internal/gateway/video.go), so they now appear in both places.

Found while adding Ark-key Seedance videos for axelburks (Discord). Not changed there: changing what `textModel` keeps reaches every provider's list and wants its own run.

comments.body:
Root cause: an Ark key's own `/models` offers its Seedance video models beside its chat models, marking no kind. catalog's row filter (`textModel`, asked while the vendor list is read) drops known non-chat ids like "sora" but not "seedance", so `doubao-seedance-*` rows were saved into the live list as chat models and `Provider.Available()` listed them to agents — where an agent picking one gets an error from Ark. Since 93060c98d the same ids are also offered as video models (`arkVideoModel` reads the chat list), so they appeared in both places.

Fix: mark the row where it belongs rather than dropping it. A vendor list's id naming Seedance is now a films model (`catalog.FilmsID`, beside `DrawsID`), like a `"kind": "video"` row its list marks no kind of. `catalog.Live`/`catalog.Chat` keep films models out of chat lists, and `LiveVideomakers` keeps offering them as video models, which `customVideomakers` already reads. `gateway.arkVideoModel` now delegates to `catalog.FilmsID`, one predicate in one place.

I deliberately did not take the other reading of adding "seedance" to `textModel`'s dropped words: the live fetch `continue`s such rows before they are saved, so the ids would leave the saved list the Ark video path reads, and an unpicked Seedance video model would vanish from the video list as well — regressing "those its list has" from 93060c98d. Marking the row films fixes the chat list and keeps the video list whole.

Verification:
- New regression tests, red on clean main: `TestFetchSeedanceIsFilms` (internal/catalog) and `TestArkKeySeedanceNotChatModels` (internal/gateway) — the Ark key's chat list held both Seedance ids before, and holds none after, while they stay video models.
- `go test ./internal/catalog/`, `./internal/provider/`, gateway `-run "Ark|Volcengine|Video|Videomaker|Film|Seedance"` and the full `./internal/gateway/` suite all pass; gofmt/vet/build clean.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/4955-seedance-not-chat (a989e8e39)

Boundary: only the catalog row classification and the duplicated gateway predicate changed; the video request path and picked Seedance ids are untouched (`TestArkKeyMakesSeedanceVideos`, `TestArkVideoTakesLastFrameAndItsOwnFields` still pass). A non-Ark relay listing Seedance ids now offers them at its videos API the same way a `kind: "video"` row is; not verified against a real relay. Not tried against a real Ark account.

This is a fork branch, ready for review, not a claim on the issue's ownership.
